name: yoga-plex
instructions:
1. Stand in an upright position with your feet together and arms at your sides.
2. Step forward into a deep lunge pattern with the back leg extended and place both palms flat on a box in front of you.
3. With your hands flat on the box, exhale, rotate your torso, and reach toward the ceiling with the arm closest to your instep.
4. Follow your hand with your eyes as you rotate.
5. Rotate back to the starting position and repeat for the desired number of repetitions on each side.
